title: Average order value
statementMd:
What is the average value of an order (over orders that have items), rounded to 2 decimals?

Expected columns: `avg_order_value`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compute per-order totals in a CTE first.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM order_items oi GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM totals;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
